newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Products to open 42 stores in FY97.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Products to open 42 stores in FY97.

text.p: Consolidated Products Inc said Thursday it plans to open 32 company-operated and 10 franchised restaurants in fiscal 1997.
The fiscal 1997 first quarter for the company, which operates Steak n Shake restaurants, ended December 18.
At the end of the first quarter, 221 Steak n Shake restaurants, including 49 franchised, were being operated, the company said.
Earlier Thursday, the company reported net income for the first quarter of $3.2 million, or $0.21 a share, compared with $2.8 million, or $0.18 a share, a year ago.
